keywords: District Court action filed by non-resident for recovery of certain sum based on an agreement for sale of shares; whether purchase price determined by Controller of Exchange would be different from agreed upon price by the parties; Sections 45 to 47. Held - failure to appeal final decision results in doctrine of estoppel. Appeal dismissed without costs.
